hits.title: Spark Perceptions Debuts Aurora at MJBizCon 2025 - Marijuana Business Conference & Expo
hits.snippet: Spark Perceptions debuts Aurora, the automatic precision combustion device redefining performance and design at MJBizCon 2025 — not a vape. Spark Perceptions, a Massachusetts-based technology startup specializing in automatic precision combustion systems, today announced the debut of its flagship device, Aurora, at MJBizCon 2025 in Las Vegas. After months of R&D and engineering refinement, Aurora has completed its engineering validation and is now preparing for mass production. Designed for users who value pure combustion, material efficiency, and effortless handling, Aurora represents the next generation of precision combustion technology — now featuring automatic control that delivers consistent performance with every use. The product embodies Spark Perceptions’ mission to merge scientific precision with practical usability. By launching Aurora at MJBizCon, Spark Perceptions aims to connect with distributors, retail buyers, and technology reviewers who share its vision of elevating combustion technology through design-driven engineering and performance excellence.
